commitResults.messageBody:
Move load and save failure rendering out of MyBff into Ui, preserving
the exact text and existing rollback behavior. MyBff now coordinates
operations without writing console responses directly, preparing for
a separate Storage extraction in the next increment.

Remove the leftover 100-task checks from additions and startup loading.
TaskList already uses a growing collection, and the existing UI plan
expects more than 100 tasks. Cover loading 101 tasks, adding a 102nd,
and preserving the full list across restart. Align the stale storage-test
expectation with the existing save error text.

Give the regular JAR the plain classifier so it no longer collides with
the runnable mybff.jar. This resolves Gradle's overlapping-output errors
when building the application distributions.

Trace intermittent growth-test failures to AccessDeniedException during
atomic replacement on Windows. Retry only access-denied replacement up
to five times, waiting 100 ms between attempts. Preserve atomic writes,
temporary-file cleanup, bounded failure handling, interruption status,
and in-memory rollback. Add real Windows file-lock checks for successful
recovery after a brief lock and unchanged data after a persistent lock.

Validation with Java 25.0.4:
- All eight exact-output UI cases pass, including growth beyond 100 tasks.
- Saving, restart, migration, malformed-file, rollback, and large-list
  persistence checks pass.
- Temporary and persistent Windows file-lock cases pass with exact
  console responses, saved-file assertions, and temporary-file cleanup.
- Gradle build succeeds; runnable-JAR deletion, restart, empty-list, and
  failed-save rollback checks pass.
- Refresh the test plans and retain the full console session records.
